title: Add human source comparison and research workflow
objective: Humans can compare selected sources and assemble a supported research workflow.
outcome: Human comparisons use the same evidence as compare_assets. Unknown and not-comparable dimensions are explicit. No numeric overall quality score hides differences. If planner remains disabled, the workspace still offers supported comparison/export and does not imply plan compilation occurred. A beginner cannot mistake negotiated rates for patient bills. The user always sees why a selected pair may not join or compare. plan_research remains disabled. worker/index.mjs does not import enrichment. HTTP 200 is not a completed research task. Last-good generation live-2026-09-03-85b50522b420 is unchanged.

commits.subject: Build evidence-based comparison views
commits.instructions: Show coverage, grain, time, measures, access, test status and join compatibility for two to five sources using the shared API result.
commits.verification: Unknown and not-comparable dimensions are explicit; no numeric overall quality score hides the differences.

commits.subject: Connect selections to documented steps
commits.instructions: Display the accepted research packet or gated plan output with source contributions, field requirements, access actions and missing needs.
commits.verification: If planner remains disabled, the workspace still offers supported comparison/export and does not imply plan compilation occurred.

commits.subject: Test financial and pricing decisions
commits.instructions: Walk through HCRIS/PHC4 and hospital/payer MRF comparisons. Keep price types and reporting periods clear in narrow layouts.
commits.verification: A beginner cannot mistake negotiated rates for patient bills based on the comparison labels; advanced context remains inspectable.
